params.body:
Closes #1004

remove.bg's self-service API stops accepting requests on 1 December 2026 at 09:00 CET. This adds the platform's own cut-out service and a driver switch in front of the call, with remove.bg still the default: merging changes nothing in production until `BACKGROUND_REMOVAL=cutout` is set.

## The service (`services/cutout`)

A small FastAPI app, three steps, open models, one container or one Python process:

1. **Gate.** CLIP (ViT-B/32, zero-shot) says whether the photo is an exterior shot of a car. Below the threshold (0.9) the photo is kept: the background comes off around the car, never in an interior or on a detail. On the 24-photo trial of 2026-10-12 the four exteriors scored 0.97 to 1.00, every interior and detail stayed under 0.80.
2. **Cut-out.** `u2net` through rembg (0.3 s and 0.8 GB on a 4-thread CPU; `isnet-general-use` is the heavier option, BiRefNet is not feasible on CPU).
3. **Compose.** The dealer's background scaled to cover the photo, a shadow under the car, the car on top. No background configured: a neutral studio ground.

Contract (also in the README): `GET /health`, `POST /cutout` multipart with `image` and an optional `background`; a cut-out comes back as `image/png` with `X-Cutout-Outcome: cut`, an interior as JSON `{"outcome": "kept", "reason": "no_car"}`, unreadable bytes as 422. A bearer token when `CUTOUT_TOKEN` is set. Plates are not touched here; Blurit stays as it is.

Tested with stand-in models (12 tests, no downloads) and end to end with the real models: an exterior with a dealer background came back cut, two interiors came back kept, garbage came back 422, a missing token 401.

## The platform side

- `App\Services\Cutout\BackgroundRemover`: one contract, two drivers. `RemoveBgRemover` is the existing call moved as it was (multipart, `bg_image_file`, `size=preview`, `type=car`, the closed refusal list of R S1-6.43). `CutoutServiceRemover` speaks the contract above and maps `kept` and `refused` onto the same `PhotoFailure` reasons, so the original stands in as the cut-out exactly as with remove.bg (R S1-6.8).
- `Photo::old_remove_background` keeps everything around the call (reading the original, the background bytes, writing the cut-out and its thumbnail, the stand-in on a refusal, the fault path) and no longer knows which service answered.
- `App\Support\BackgroundRemoval` reads `BACKGROUND_REMOVAL` (`removebg`, the default, or `cutout`); the name doubles as the service name for the outbound seal, so a staging box lists `cutout` in `OUTBOUND_ALLOW`. `ProcessImage` and `PlatformPhotoService` ask the seal about the driver in use.
- `stocklist:smoke cutout` and the Koppelingen pane read `/health` (model names, version, whether the driver is in use); the environment block names the background-removal driver.
- New rule R S1-6.46; R P3-7.7 and R P3-13.1 list the service.

Tests: `OwnCutoutServiceTest` (driver switch, the cut-out on the vehicles disk, the background as a file part, kept and refused as outcomes without a report, a fault reported and the photo left alone, the seal by the driver's own name, the smoke line). The existing remove.bg tests pass unchanged.

## What this does not do yet

- Run anywhere. The service needs a machine of its own (a container or a small VM with 4 GB, not the Forge box next to PHP); which one is the owner's call. Until then production stays on remove.bg.
- Replace Blurit. That is a second round with its own trial.
params.title: Own cut-out service behind a driver switch, remove.bg stays the default
